# Security policy

Stadje is a hobby project with no accounts and no player data stored server-side (see
[Privacy](../app/privacy) and constitution Principle V in
[`.specify/memory/constitution.md`](../.specify/memory/constitution.md)) — the realistic attack
surface is small, but reports are still welcome.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't open a public issue for a security problem. Instead, email
**pascalroose@outlook.com** with:

- What you found and why it's a security issue
- Steps to reproduce
- Impact, if you can assess it

This is a solo-maintained hobby project, so there's no guaranteed response time, but reports will
be read and taken seriously.
